title: Liverpool to monitor Germany midfielder Florian Neuhaus at Euros
trail: The Germany midfielder Florian Neuhaus is a potential summer transfer target for Liverpool as they consider replacements for Georginio Wijnaldum
body: The Germany midfielder Florian Neuhaus is a potential summer transfer target for Liverpool as they consider replacements for Georginio Wijnaldum. Liverpool have been monitoring the Borussia Mönchengladbach player and will maintain a watching brief at the European Championship. The 24-year-old, who recently denied he was bound for Bayern Munich, is understood to have a release clause of about €40m (£34.3m). The midfielder is one of several options under consideration at Liverpool although it is not guaranteed they will sign a replacement for Wijnaldum, who joined Paris Saint-Germain on a free transfer this week. Jürgen Klopp, who has strengthened in central defence with the £36m signing of Ibrahima Konaté, is keen to hand Curtis Jones more opportunities.
